storylines.storyline_label: Durable agent-execution substrate (cloud sandboxes vs local swarms)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: M&A: OpenAI announced June 11 acquisition of Ona (formerly Gitpod), folding its persistent cloud-sandbox runtime into the Codex group

storylines.storyline_label: Moonshot Kimi open-weight line (Kimi Work local agent and K2.7-Code model)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Kimi K2.7-Code open-weight coding model published to Hugging Face under Modified MIT (1T-param MoE, ~32B active, 256K ctx) with only self-reported benchmarks

storylines.storyline_label: On-device fine-tuning stack converging into a single local app (Unsloth)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New release shipped: Unsloth 2026.6.7 beta (150+ PRs) adding DiffusionGemma training, Gemma 4 multi-token prediction, audio chat, GGUF tensor parallelism and ~3x-leaner QAT

storylines.storyline_label: Open-weight SSM-hybrid (Mamba2) vision-language models for edge
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Zyphra released Zamba2-VL (1.2B/2.7B/7B) under Apache 2.0 with Hugging Face checkpoints, ~order-of-magnitude lower time-to-first-token

storylines.storyline_label: US export-control directive forcing Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor public position: US government issued June 12 export-control directive (5:21pm ET) on national-security authority; Anthropic disabled both models worldwide and publicly disputed it

storylines.storyline_label: Agentic-AI security: prompt injection, coding-agent CVEs, OWASP catalog
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: OWASP published State of Agentic AI Security and Governance v2.01 (June 11) mapping prompt injection to 6/10 categories and adding a Real-World Incidents CVE tracker

storylines.storyline_label: Confidential-computing / attested-GPU private inference (Apple PCC on Google Cloud)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor public position: Apple disclosed extending Private Cloud Compute to run Apple Foundation Model inference on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in confidential mode on Google Cloud, with remote attestation and a node ledger

storylines.storyline_label: OS-level on-device agent runtime baked into device platforms (Huawei HarmonyOS 7)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Huawei unveiled HarmonyOS 7 developer beta (June 12) with Agent Framework 2.0 (Intention as Service), claiming >90% task success and ~15% uplift over 6.1

storylines.storyline_label: LLM workflow-orchestration tooling moving to assistant-generated, memory-backed flows (Langflow, n8n)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New release shipped: Langflow 1.10 (June 9) with full-flow Assistant and Memory bases, plus an n8n core/editor/AI-node reliability round

storylines.storyline_label: SpaceX record IPO carrying xAI onto public markets
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Scheduled catalyst reached: SpaceX began trading on Nasdaq (SPCX) June 12 at $135, raising ~$75B, popping ~19-20% to a $2T+ valuation with xAI inside the entity

storylines.storyline_label: AI-lab path to public markets (Anthropic confidential S-1, OpenAI listing prep)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Anthropic confidentially filed a draft Form S-1 with the SEC on June 1 ($965B post-money, run-rate past $47B); OpenAI targeting a $60B+ raise at up to $1T

storylines.storyline_label: AI-capex funding scare repricing the semiconductor complex (Oracle $95B guide)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Numeric threshold crossed: Oracle guided FY2027 capex to as much as $95B (up from $55.66B), falling ~8.9% after-hours and dragging the PHLX Semiconductor Index down 3.57%

storylines.storyline_label: Long-horizon agent-memory research (arXiv papers and benchmarks)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: EvoArena (arXiv:2606.13681) benchmarks agents at 39.6% accuracy under environment change and proposes patch-based EvoMem; paired with the Agentic Software paradigm paper (arXiv:2606.05608)

storylines.storyline_label: Bay Area / summer AI-event calendar (mainstream-dev, AI-security, AI-chip tracks)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Scheduled catalyst reached: Databricks Data + AI Summit imminent (June 15-18) as the next live anchor; WWDC26 fully dropped, downstream Confidential Computing Summit / AMD Advancing AI / Hot Chips held
